result.summary: Two workers are performing steel erection at high elevation. One worker on the left is wearing a harness with lanyard hanging unsecured. Another worker on the right is walking and standing on an elevated steel beam without any visible fall protection system tied off.

ppe.notes: Both workers wear hard hats. High-visibility vests are not visible. Lanyards/harnesses are present on the worker in the foreground but are not tied off.

findings.description: Worker is walking and working on a narrow elevated steel beam at high-rise level without any fall arrest system or safety harness connected.
findings.location_in_image: Center-right, standing on the upper horizontal steel beam
findings.corrective_action: Halt work immediately, require 100% tie-off with retractable lifelines or personal fall arrest systems, and install temporary safety cable systems or nets.

findings.description: Worker in the foreground is wearing a harness, but the lanyards are hanging down unattached to any anchor point.
findings.location_in_image: Left side, standing on foreground steel beam
findings.corrective_action: Ensure the worker immediately hooks lanyards to an approved structural anchor point or lifeline before performing elevated tasks.

findings.description: Crane load line and ball block operating in close proximity to ironworkers guiding a suspended steel beam.
findings.location_in_image: Upper center, suspended crane ball and steel beam
findings.corrective_action: Ensure tag lines are used to control suspended loads and maintain clear communication between the crane operator and signal person.

immediate_actions: Halt unanchored elevated steel work immediately.
Enforce mandatory 100% tie-off for all workers at height.
Inspect and ensure all harnesses and lanyards are properly connected to certified anchor points.
result.image_quality_note: Clear vintage site photograph showing the entire work area and workers at height.
